references.text: The Brook Kanah is also mentioned as the boundary of the tribe of Manasseh, showing how the territories of Ephraim and Manasseh bordered each other.
Tappuah is mentioned as one of the cities conquered by Joshua, the same city from which the boundary runs in this verse.
Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, but the land around Tappuah belonged to the children of Ephraim, which completes the description of the border area.
Earlier in the chapter, the eastern boundary of Ephraim's inheritance is described, and this verse completes the description of the tribe's territory.
The clans of Ephraim are mentioned in the census, the same clans that inherited the land described in this verse.
